automated_checks_outcome_success.rationale: automated-checks.json has top-level "outcome": "success" with all three executed_commands (compileall, managed_projects validate, run_test_groups --all) reporting exit_code 0.

required_artifacts_present.rationale: .managed-task.json declares proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md, specs/agent-runtime/spec.md as artifacts; ls on the archived change dir confirms all four exist on disk.

spec_delta_present.rationale: specs/agent-runtime/spec.md in the archive is a non-empty 83-line file with 7 ADDED Requirements and scenarios, matching the new openspec/specs/agent-runtime/spec.md target spec.

scope_respected.rationale: Every changed file (adapter script + template mirror, contract tests, docs + template mirror, cordis observation profile, pinned requirements, checks.toml/.dev-platform.toml entries, spec delta, and a narrow reuse-oriented rename in model_routing.py) maps directly to a proposal.md 'What Changes' bullet; no unrelated subsystem is touched.

suspicious_scope_expansion.rationale: No task-intake, routing-default, publication, or rollout logic was altered; the only touch to shared code (model_routing.py) is a like-for-like rename of private helpers to public ones with identical behavior, which design.md explicitly anticipates for reuse.

test_evidence_sufficient.rationale: 16 new unit tests (verified by running them live, all pass) cover disabled-by-default, exact-version gating, missing/mismatched installs, host support, usage normalization edge cases, process-group cleanup, write-containment refusal, and doc parity, plus a platform-wide regression run; docked one point because the only 'real' DSH execution path (host smoke) is honestly reported as BLOCKED rather than exercised.

regression_risk.rationale: The feature is fully isolated behind an explicit disabled-by-default config flag and a self-contained new module; the only shared-code touch is a verified no-op rename in model_routing.py with no other call sites found, so blast radius to existing behavior is low.

security_sensitive_surface_touch.rationale: The adapter introduces a new external-process execution path, references a new API-key env var (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY) for the upstream SDK, includes explicit secret-redaction regexes for subprocess output, and implements fail-closed write/workspace containment logic (delegation_containment) -- all credential- and write-boundary-adjacent surfaces.

migration_config_release_impact.rationale: Adds a new [experimental_runtime.deepseek_harness] section to both .dev-platform.toml and its Copier template (template/.dev-platform.toml.jinja), plus a new checks.toml target and a new optional requirements file -- a real (opt-in, default-off) configuration-contract change for downstream managed projects rendered via Copier.

suspicious_large_or_unrelated_diff.rationale: 1909 insertions is large in absolute terms, but proposal.md explicitly scopes a new adapter + pinned dependency + docs + template mirror + contract tests + spec delta; every changed file traces to that stated scope with no stray/unrelated files.

verification_contradiction.rationale: Spot-checked two specific claims against code: the 'workspace-write refuses before worker launch' claim matches _require_available raising AdapterError('containment_unavailable', ...) in the diff, and the 'BLOCKED on darwin/x86_64, no supported wheel' claim matches _host_supported(), which only allows linux x86_64/aarch64 and darwin arm64/aarch64 (darwin x86_64 excluded) -- both consistent with the diff.

human_review_recommended.rationale: This is a novel external-runtime integration (new subprocess execution, new external SDK dependency, new secret-adjacent surface, process-lifecycle/containment logic) -- the kind of architecturally significant, cross-system change the platform's own routing_receipt flags with strong_trigger 'novel_cross_system' and recommended_start_tier R3, warranting mandatory human sign-off beyond automated checks.

action_recommendation.rationale: All artifact/process evidence is internally consistent and complete (checklist, verification PASS, automated-checks success, spec delta, matching diff), the feature is disabled-by-default and fails closed on containment, and spot checks found no contradictions -- the candidate is safe to accept, though the underlying change class still merits the human review it appears to have already received via PR #313.
